svg.title: Spiking neuron models: Hodgkin-Huxley and Izhikevich
svg.desc: Membrane traces of the Hodgkin-Huxley model and four Izhikevich firing classes, and their f-I curves.
svg.text: Spiking models: one conductance model, four two-variable classes
F f-I curves, rate in Hz (noise-free)
Hodgkin and Huxley's model needs four coupled equations and a dozen rate functions; Izhikevich's two-variable model reproduces the same firing classes at a fraction of the cost.
